# Pace

> On-device Mac voice agent that reads your screen and acts with local context.

## When to use this

Reach for Pace when you need a fully on-device macOS voice agent that transcribes speech, reads your screen, plans actions, and executes approved macOS actions — all locally, with no cloud LLM, STT, TTS, or telemetry. Best-fit jobs:

- Voice-driven macOS automation with privacy (no cloud calls)
- Screen-aware voice assistance (reads what's on screen via a local VLM)
- On-device meeting notes and action capture
- Local TTS streaming from a menu-bar voice agent

Do not use Pace for: cloud-based voice assistants, cross-platform (non-macOS) voice tools, or anything that requires sending audio or screen content to a remote server.

## CLI

No CLI tool is currently available. Pace is a macOS menu-bar application —
download it from [heypace.app/download](https://heypace.app/download).
